description: Land Acquisition - Appointment under land acquisition Act, that Mrs. N. B. Nanayakkara & Mr. G. A. C. De Silva as acquiring officers from 01.03.2017 for two year period
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It appoints officers to function as Acquiring Officers for land acquisitions made for Road Development Projects, which falls under land and property-related administrative matters. While it mentions appointments of named individuals, the primary focus is on land acquisition procedures and authority assignments for specific land development projects, making it a Land Gazette rather than a government personnel classification.
